title: Three-view Target workbench
intent: Make execution, version-bound delivery, and activity inspectable without nine competing tabs.
scope: Target workbench UI, locale strings, navigation contract, and focused tests.
non_goals: Approve a delivery or external action
acceptance_criteria: Three primary views retain legacy tab links and immutable revisions.
Graph inspection connects work to runs and artifacts while preserving execution controls.
Candidate artifacts, verification results, evidence, reviews, and acceptance stay version-bound.
Activity is newest-first; routine records remain recoverable and unknown or failed events remain visible.
Text previews remain bounded and cannot execute markup.
